api-limits#rate-limits.heading: Rate limits
api-limits#rate-limits.text: The public API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

api-limits#pagination.heading: Pagination
api-limits#pagination.text: List endpoints return up to 100 items per page. Use the next_cursor field to fetch the next page.

data-export#export-api.heading: Export API
data-export#export-api.text: Workspace exports now run through the POST /v2/exports endpoint and are delivered as Parquet or JSON. The legacy CSV export in Settings has been removed.

pricing#plans.heading: Plans
pricing#plans.text: The Starter plan costs 10 EUR per user per month. The Pro plan costs 29 EUR per user per month. Enterprise pricing is custom and negotiated with sales.

pricing#annual-billing.heading: Annual billing
pricing#annual-billing.text: Annual billing gives a 20% discount compared with monthly billing. Annual plans are invoiced up front.

refunds#refund-window.heading: Refund window
refunds#refund-window.text: Monthly plans can be refunded within 14 days of the charge. Annual plans are refunded pro rata for unused months.

refunds#how-to-request.heading: How to request
refunds#how-to-request.text: Open Billing > Invoices, select the charge and click Request refund. Refunds are processed in 5 to 7 business days.

sso#saml-sso.heading: SAML SSO
sso#saml-sso.text: SAML SSO is available on the Enterprise plan only. Configure it under Settings > Security > SSO.

sso#scim-provisioning.heading: SCIM provisioning
sso#scim-provisioning.text: SCIM user provisioning is now supported on the Enterprise plan. Connect Okta or Azure AD under Settings > Security > SCIM.
